```{=html}
<script>
window.fitScaledWriteupFrame = function(frame) {
  const content = frame.querySelector(".scaled-frame-content");
  const sourceWidth = Number(frame.dataset.sourceWidth);
  const sourceHeight = Number(frame.dataset.sourceHeight);
  if (!content || !sourceWidth || !sourceHeight) return;

  const displayWidth = frame.clientWidth;
  if (!displayWidth) return;

  const scale = Math.min(1, displayWidth / sourceWidth);
  const extraHeight = Number(frame.dataset.extraHeight || 0);
  frame.style.maxWidth = "100%";
  frame.style.height = `${Math.ceil(sourceHeight * scale + extraHeight)}px`;
  frame.style.overflow = "hidden";
  content.style.width = `${sourceWidth}px`;
  content.style.height = `${sourceHeight}px`;
  content.style.display = content.dataset.scaledDisplay || "block";
  content.style.transformOrigin = "top left";
  content.style.transform = `scale(${scale})`;
};

window.fitAllScaledWriteupFrames = function(root) {
  (root || document)
    .querySelectorAll(".scaled-frame")
    .forEach((frame) => window.fitScaledWriteupFrame(frame));
};

window.tabPaneForWriteupFrame = function(frame) {
  let node = frame.parentElement;
  while (node && node.parentElement) {
    if (node.parentElement.classList.contains("tab-content")) return node;
    node = node.parentElement;
  }
  return null;
};

window.canHydrateWriteupFrame = function(frame) {
  const tabset = frame.closest(".panel-tabset");
  if (tabset) {
    const panes = Array.from(tabset.querySelectorAll(".tab-content > div"));
    const tabsetReady = panes.length <= 1 || panes.some((pane) => pane.hidden);
    const pane = window.tabPaneForWriteupFrame(frame);
    if (!tabsetReady || (pane && pane.hidden)) return false;
  }
  const rect = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
  return Boolean(rect.width && rect.height && frame.offsetParent !== null);
};

window.hydrateScaledWriteupFrames = function(root) {
  (root || document)
    .querySelectorAll("iframe.metric-frame[data-src]")
    .forEach((frame) => {
      if (frame.getAttribute("src")) return;
      if (!window.canHydrateWriteupFrame(frame)) return;
      frame.setAttribute("src", frame.dataset.src);
    });
};

window.dehydrateHiddenScaledWriteupFrames = function(root) {
  (root || document)
    .querySelectorAll("iframe.metric-frame[data-src][src]")
    .forEach((frame) => {
      const pane = window.tabPaneForWriteupFrame(frame);
      if (pane && pane.hidden) frame.removeAttribute("src");
    });
};

window.refreshScaledWriteupFrames = function(root) {
  window.dehydrateHiddenScaledWriteupFrames(root || document);
  window.hydrateScaledWriteupFrames(root);
  window.fitAllScaledWriteupFrames(root);
};

window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh = function(root) {
  requestAnimationFrame(() =>
    requestAnimationFrame(() => window.refreshScaledWriteupFrames(root))
  );
};

window.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(document);
  window.addEventListener("load", () => window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(document));
  if ("ResizeObserver" in window) {
    const obs = new ResizeObserver((entries) =>
      entries.forEach((entry) => window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(entry.target))
    );
    document
      .querySelectorAll(".scaled-frame")
      .forEach((frame) => obs.observe(frame));
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("resize", () =>
      window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(document)
    );
  }
  document.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", (event) => {
    window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(event.target.closest(".panel-tabset"));
  });
  document.addEventListener("tabby", (event) => {
    window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(event.target.closest(".panel-tabset"));
  });
  if (window.Reveal && typeof window.Reveal.on === "function") {
    window.Reveal.on("slidechanged", () =>
      window.scheduleScaledWriteupRefresh(document)
    );
  }
});
</script>
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd

CAMPAIGN = "kdvi_dsivi_toy_default_sweep_10seed"
DATA_DIR = Path("data") / CAMPAIGN
PLOT_DIR = Path("assets") / "plotly" / CAMPAIGN
VISUAL_MANIFEST = DATA_DIR / "visual_manifest.json"
PLOTLY_SOURCE_WIDTH = 1000
PLOTLY_SOURCE_HEIGHT = 420
VISUAL_SOURCE_WIDTH = 1100
VISUAL_SOURCE_HEIGHT = 500
TARGET_ORDER = [
    "banana",
    "x_shaped",
    "multimodal",
    "8_gaussians",
    "8_gaussians_small",
    "student_uc",
    "Langevin_post",
]
METRIC_ORDER = [
    ("kl_ite", "KL-ITE", "KL"),
    ("w2", "Sliced W2", "W2"),
    ("elbo", "ELBO", "ELBO"),
    ("kde_expected_log_marginal", "KDE ELM", "KDE ELM"),
]
TARGET_LABELS = {
    "banana": "banana",
    "x_shaped": "x_shaped",
    "multimodal": "multimodal",
    "8_gaussians": "8_gaussians",
    "8_gaussians_small": "8_gaussians_small",
    "student_uc": "student_uc",
    "Langevin_post": "Langevin_post",
}


def fmt(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return "-"
    return f"{value:.4g}"


def read_manifest():
    if not VISUAL_MANIFEST.exists():
        return {}
    return json.loads(VISUAL_MANIFEST.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def target_id(target):
    return target.replace("_", "-").lower()


def frame_epoch(frame):
    return frame.get("epoch", frame.get("step", ""))


def count_value(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return 0
    return int(value)


def metric_value(item, metric):
    mean_col = f"{metric}_final_mean"
    std_col = f"{metric}_final_std"
    count_col = f"{metric}_final_count"
    if mean_col not in item or count_value(item.get(count_col, 0)) == 0:
        return "-"
    std = item.get(std_col)
    if pd.isna(std):
        return fmt(item[mean_col])
    return f"{fmt(item[mean_col])} +/- {fmt(std)}"


def target_metric_table(target_rows):
    cols = ["Method", "Runs"]
    for _, table_label, _ in METRIC_ORDER:
        cols.append(table_label)

    rows = []
    for method in ["KDVI", "DSIVI"]:
        row = target_rows[target_rows["method"] == method]
        if row.empty:
            continue
        item = row.iloc[0]
        values = [method, str(int(item["run_count"]))]
        for metric, _, _ in METRIC_ORDER:
            values.append(metric_value(item, metric))
        rows.append(values)
    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols)


summary_path = DATA_DIR / "final_metrics.csv"
if not summary_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Missing {summary_path}. Run "
        f"`python writeup/scripts/fetch_wandb_campaign.py {CAMPAIGN}` first."
    )

summary = pd.read_csv(summary_path)
visuals = read_manifest()

for target in TARGET_ORDER:
    target_label = TARGET_LABELS[target]
    target_html_id = target_id(target)
    target_rows = summary[summary["target"] == target]
    print(f'<section id="results-{target_html_id}"><h2>{target_label}</h2>')
    print(
        '<p class="target-definition-link">'
        f'<a href="implementation.html#sec-target-{target_html_id}">'
        "Target definition</a></p>"
    )
    print('::: {.panel-tabset .target-tabs}')
    print('')
    plotted = False
    for metric, _, tab_label in METRIC_ORDER:
        plot_path = PLOT_DIR / f"{target}_{metric}.html"
        if plot_path.exists():
            plotted = True
            print(f"## {tab_label}")
            print("")
            print(
                '<div class="scaled-frame scaled-plotly-frame" '
                f'data-source-width="{PLOTLY_SOURCE_WIDTH}" '
                f'data-source-height="{PLOTLY_SOURCE_HEIGHT}" '
                'data-extra-height="8">'
                f'<iframe class="metric-frame scaled-frame-content" '
                f'data-src="{plot_path.as_posix()}" '
                f'width="{PLOTLY_SOURCE_WIDTH}" height="{PLOTLY_SOURCE_HEIGHT}" '
                'scrolling="no" '
                'onload="window.fitScaledWriteupFrame(this.parentElement);">'
                '</iframe></div>'
            )
            print("")
    if not plotted:
        print("## No Plots")
        print("")
        print("No metric plot is available for this target.")
        print("")

    print("## Visuals")
    print("")
    target_visual = visuals.get(target, {})
    groundtruth = target_visual.get("groundtruth")
    posterior = target_visual.get("posterior", [])
    if groundtruth and posterior:
        slider_id = f"slider-{target_html_id}"
        img_id = f"posterior-{target_html_id}"
        caption_id = f"caption-{target_html_id}"
        first = posterior[0]
        print(
            '<div class="scaled-frame scaled-visual-frame" '
            f'data-source-width="{VISUAL_SOURCE_WIDTH}" '
            f'data-source-height="{VISUAL_SOURCE_HEIGHT}">'
        )
        print('<div class="visual-grid scaled-frame-content" data-scaled-display="grid">')
        print('<div class="visual-panel">')
        print('<h3>Groundtruth</h3>')
        print(f'<img src="{groundtruth}" alt="Groundtruth samples for {target}">')
        print('</div>')
        print('<div class="visual-panel posterior-panel">')
        print('<h3>KDVI posterior, seed 7</h3>')
        print(
            f'<img id="{img_id}" src="{first["path"]}" '
            f'alt="KDVI posterior samples for {target}">'
        )
        print(
            f'<input id="{slider_id}" type="range" min="0" '
            f'max="{len(posterior) - 1}" value="0" step="1">'
        )
        print(
            f'<div id="{caption_id}" class="posterior-caption">'
            f'epoch {frame_epoch(first)}</div>'
        )
        print('</div>')
        print('</div>')
        print('</div>')
        payload = json.dumps(posterior)
        print("<script>")
        print(
            f"(function(){{const frames={payload};"
            f"const slider=document.getElementById('{slider_id}');"
            f"const image=document.getElementById('{img_id}');"
            f"const caption=document.getElementById('{caption_id}');"
            "if(!slider||!image||!caption){return;}"
            "function update(){const item=frames[Number(slider.value)];"
            "const epoch=(item.epoch ?? item.step);"
            "image.src=item.path; caption.textContent='epoch '+epoch;}"
            "slider.addEventListener('input', update); update();"
            "requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.fitAllScaledWriteupFrames(document));})();"
        )
        print("</script>")
    else:
        print("No seed-7 visualization media is available for this target.")
    print("")

    print("## Table")
    print("")
    target_table = target_metric_table(target_rows)
    if target_table.empty:
        print("No final metric summary is available for this target.")
    else:
        print(f'<h3>{target_label} final metrics</h3>')
        print('<div class="metric-table target-metric-table">')
        print(target_table.to_html(index=False, escape=False))
        print("</div>")
    print("")

    print(":::")
    print("</section>")
```
